issues.what: The interpretive label 'session memory beyond the hour effect / mean-reverting' is only as fine as the pre-registered hour_bin cells; a residual within-hour clock component and a structural consecutive-trade coupling are not excluded or discussed. Re-running the same N1 machinery with finer clock cells shrinks the excess: session x 30-min cells give +34..+58 INR (p 0.004-0.03, 2,245 movable rows); session x 15-min cells give +7..+28 INR (p 0.02-0.52, 964 movable rows). Descriptively, after a stop_loss the next SETUP arrives after a median 13 bars vs 26.5 after next_choch and flips direction 78% of the time, a mechanical channel the reading does not mention. This does not touch the null-result conclusion (no key), and the reverse rule is already flagged as untested.
